hero.name: Boris Sargsyan
hero.tagline: Studying how systems break so I can help build ones that don't.
hero.intro: Cybersecurity student at Marist University focused on network security, secure system design, and applied penetration testing. Previously completed the IB Diploma at UWC Dilijan, where a school network security project first got me hooked on this field.

about.heading: About
paragraphs: I'm a cybersecurity student at Marist University with a growing focus on network defense, secure system design, and offensive security fundamentals. My interest in this field started at UWC Dilijan, where I helped audit and harden the school's own network as an independent project.

Since then I've kept building: home lab environments, small security tools, and write-ups documenting what I learn along the way. I'm currently preparing for entry-level certifications and looking for an internship where I can apply what I've built in a real security team.

projects.title: Campus Network Vulnerability Scanner
projects.description: A Python tool that scans a lab network for outdated services and common misconfigurations, then generates a plain-language remediation report for non-technical staff.

projects.title: Intentionally Vulnerable Login Portal
projects.description: A deliberately vulnerable login application built to practice and teach common web authentication flaws (SQL injection, broken session handling, weak password policies) with accompanying fixes.

projects.title: Password Strength & Breach Checker
projects.description: A client-side tool that scores password strength and checks it against known breach datasets using k-anonymity, without ever sending the full password over the network.

projects.title: Phishing Simulation Dashboard
projects.description: A dashboard for running authorized phishing awareness campaigns for a student organization, tracking click and report rates to measure security awareness over time.

timeline.title: B.S. Cybersecurity
timeline.description: Coursework in network security, applied cryptography, and systems administration. Active member of the Cybersecurity Club.

timeline.title: IT Security Intern
timeline.description: Assisted with quarterly vulnerability scans, monitored SIEM alerts, and helped triage phishing reports across small-business client environments.

timeline.title: Cybersecurity Club — Member
timeline.description: Participate in weekly CTF practice and help organize introductory security workshops for new students.

timeline.title: IB Diploma
timeline.description: Completed the International Baccalaureate Diploma. Led an independent project auditing and hardening the school's network, which sparked an interest in cybersecurity.
